parameters.content:
## Journeys v2
Queue `q.n8n.journeys`:
- **user.signed_up / signup** → welcome + first-film pick
- **watch_complete** → what to watch next

Notify: `POST /api/internal/notify` on paystack-api.
Env: `YAKWETU_API_URL`, `INTERNAL_API_KEY` / `ADMIN_TOKEN`, `STOREFRONT_URL`.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: ($env.OPENROUTER_MODEL || 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'), temperature: 0.7, max_tokens: 120, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You write one short Yakwetu Sinema message (Kenyan pay-per-film). Return JSON {"message": "..."}. Max 110 chars. Warm Kenyan English. Use only given facts. No links, emojis, or hashtags. End so a link reads naturally after it.' },{ role: 'user', content: 'First name: ' + String($json.firstName||$json.name||'there') + '
' + 'Pick film: ' + String($json.filmTitle||$json.pickTitle||'') + '
' + 'Why: welcome / first film
' + 'Price hint: KES ' + String($json.priceKes||5) }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: ($env.OPENROUTER_MODEL || 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'), temperature: 0.7, max_tokens: 120, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You write one short Yakwetu Sinema message (Kenyan pay-per-film). Return JSON {"message": "..."}. Max 110 chars. Warm Kenyan English. Use only given facts. No links, emojis, or hashtags. End so a link reads naturally after it.' },{ role: 'user', content: 'First name: ' + String($json.firstName||$json.name||'there') + '
' + 'Just watched: ' + String($json.watchedTitle||$json.filmTitle||'') + '
' + 'Next pick: ' + String($json.pickTitle||$json.nextTitle||'') + '
' + 'Why: after-watch rec' }] }) }}

nodes.name: API already sent (skip n8n notify)
nodes.notes: Customer SMS/email is sent by paystack-api when the event is ingested. n8n must not send again (prevents 4x duplicates).
